reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited text supports it: 24.1 gives Customer an unconditional affiliate/M&A successor assignment right on notice only, 24.2 restricts Vendor assignment, delegation and change-of-control transfer to consent not unreasonably withheld with a competitor bar, 24.3 sets a mutual reasonable-consent standard, and 24.4 expressly negates any Vendor termination, suspension, repricing, acceleration or service-reduction right on Customer's change of control.
No redline or comment was proposed, which is the correct output for a compliant finding; the rendered redline is identical to the originals and the deterministic carve-out check passes.

Section 13.3 is correctly cited as aligning licence transfer with permitted Section 24 assignments, so no carve-out is undercut; the only nuance (competitor bar phrased as subject to Customer consent rather than absolute) is immaterial since consent rests with us and is properly noted as not requiring a redline.
